# Intro Skipper test data

`blackframe-alt-3`, `blackframe-alt-4` and `blackframe-alt-5` are ffmpeg
`blackframe` keyframe scans of real episodes' credits, copied verbatim from the
Intro Skipper plugin's test suite (`IntroSkipper.Tests/fingerprints/`,
github.com/intro-skipper/intro-skipper at `db09359`, GPL-3.0-only like
Ferrofin). They are the oracle for `TestBlackFrames.TestFingerprint_Alt*`,
transliterated in `../credit_scenes.rs`.
